messages:
Priya M.: Thanks for the convo in today's all-hands. I want a short, actionable summary we can point teams at for release cadence/oncall/SLA questions.
Sam H.: TL;DR: Encourage a 3-week planning rhythm as the default to reduce mid-sprint context switches. Not mandatory 1 teams can stay at 2 or 4 weeks if the tradeoffs are deliberate. The objective is predictable planning windows, not one-size-fits-all enforcement.
Nadia R.: If teams switch cadence, do we change oncall schedules?
Sam H.: Yes 1 primary oncall will move to 7-day shifts (Mon0Sun) to reduce handoffs. Night/holiday secondary coverage stays as-is. Expect fewer total rotations per quarter.
Theo V.: Any change to paging SLAs or ack times?
Sam H.: Paging rules unchanged: Sev1 pages immediately, ack SLA 15m, mitigation plan within 30m. We will revamp runbook steps to map discrete actions to the 15/30 targets (so responders know exactly what \"mitigation plan\" looks like).
Ken P.: What are the customer-facing latency commitments for Dedicated and Hosted?
Sam H.: Comms we're aligning on: Hosted standard gen models: p95 <= 200ms. Dedicated standard profiles: p95 <= 300ms. Long-context / specialty profiles will have profile-specific SLAs documented in the model catalog (example: 64k context p95 <= 700ms).
Nadia R.: How will model rollouts be gated for quality?
Sam H.: New requirement: every model rollout must include a prerelease eval harness (baseline prompts + acceptance metrics). Two hard gates: embeddings similarity (no >2% drop vs baseline) and toxicity/regeneration checks. Canary stage required with automated metric monitoring.
Priya M.: Can we standardize a canary template we can paste into deployments?
Sam H.: Agreed. Example default canary template (teams may tune per-model):
```json
{"canary_percent":10,"stages":[10,50,100],"health_metrics":["p95_latency","error_rate","quality_regressions"],"auto_promote_on":"slo_green","auto_promote_checks":3}
```
Nadia R.: Does CI auto-promote on green?
Sam H.: Yes 1 CI will auto-promote after 3 consecutive green evaluations and 15m with no new errors. Ops can abort or rollback from the deploy dashboard.
Theo V.: Who owns updating runbooks and the post-release checklist?
Nadia R.: I will take runbook updates. Theo will own the post-release checklist and the eval prompt sets.
Ken P.: I'll coordinate customer-facing SLA language and update status pages.
Priya M.: Action list: Sam to land the canary template in infra/deploy; Nadia to refresh runbooks; Theo to publish eval harness and prompt sets; Ken to draft SLA blurb for customers. Drop PR/links into #eng-process. :thumbsup:
healthbot: deploy-bot started release/infra-2026-04 at 2150000100 :rocket:
Nadia R.: Any change to incident retrospective timing?
Sam H.: Slight update: initial incident summary within 48h, full RCA within 5 business days. We're also adding automated health checks at ~1h and 24h after major rollouts to capture regressions early.
Priya M.: Thanks all 1 please keep this thread for brief updates and move docs into #eng-process. Leadership will review progress in the next sync. :white_check_mark:
